names.details: Feyyūm: A renowned ḳaṣaba (town) in the Ṣa‘īd vilāyet (Upper Egypt province), through which the Nehr-i Yūsuf ‘aleyhi’s-selām (River of Joseph, peace be upon him) flows. It is a rarity of the age with its baths, schools, and markets. [translation]

title: Krokodilopolis/Ptolemais Euergetis
provenance: Barrington Atlas: BAtlas 75 D2 Krokodilopolis/Ptolemais Euergetis
description: An ancient city in the Heptanomis and the capital of the Arsinoites nome. The ancient Egyptian name of the site was Shedyet, and in Pharaonic times it was a major cult center for the god Sobek.
